findings.current: The Grand Mage smiled coldly at the reminder of his failure in Gansu.
findings.defect: The possessive assigns the defeat to the Blood Lord rather than the Grand Mage.
findings.rationale: The Grand Mage is the one being reminded of the failure.
findings.replacement: The Grand Mage smiled coldly at the reminder of her failure in Gansu.
findings.source: 감숙에서의 실패를 지적당한 대술사가 싸늘하게 미소 지었다.

findings.current: Even now, just remembering it made the place where that violet Sword Force had cut him ache deep in his heart—and continued to throb even after his new arm had grown in.
findings.defect: “Grown in” invents regrowth; the translation also merges his inward chill with the physical throbbing of the severed site.
findings.rationale: The source says a new arm now occupies the place, not how it got there, and distinguishes the chilling memory from the lingering pain.
findings.replacement: Even remembering that violet Sword Force sent a chill through him. The place it had severed still throbbed, even now that a new arm was in place.
findings.source: 다시 떠올리는 것만으로도 마음 한구석이 서늘해지는, 그때의 자줏빛 검강(劍罡)이 베어 냈던 부위가 새로운 팔이 자리 잡은 지금까지도 욱신거릴 만큼.

findings.current: At the Blood Lord’s question, the messenger bowed lower before answering.
findings.defect: Bowing lower loses the messenger’s prostration.
findings.rationale: 부복한 specifies that he lies prostrate, reinforcing his fear and subordinate position.
findings.replacement: At the Blood Lord’s question, the messenger lowered himself further, prostrating himself before he answered.
findings.source: 혈주의 물음에 더욱 자세를 낮추어 부복한 전령이 대답했다.

findings.current: “Shut your mouth. You weren’t even there. This is no business of yours.”
findings.defect: The Blood Lord’s direct insult to the Grand Mage is omitted, softening his anger and their hostile relationship.
findings.rationale: 네년 따위 is a contemptuous address, and 왈가왈부 dismisses her right to comment on what happened.
findings.replacement: “Shut your mouth, bitch. You weren’t even there, so you’ve got no right to run your mouth about it.”
findings.source: “주둥이 닥쳐라. 그 자리에 있지도 않았던 네년 따위가 왈가왈부할 만한 일이 아니니까.”

findings.current: “You should have consulted me before making your decision. To waste a precious magic formation, one that can only be used twice, on something like this…”
findings.defect: The singular English suggests he spent only one formation, obscuring the scale of the deployment she objects to.
findings.rationale: Her ensuing anger concerns the dozens of formations used to move the troops; each formation has only two uses.
findings.replacement: “You should have consulted me before making your decision. To waste those precious magic formations, each usable only twice, on something like this…”
findings.source: “넌 결정을 내리기에 앞서 내게 상의해야 했어. 단 두 번밖에 쓸 수 없는 귀한 마법진(魔法陳)을 고작 그런 것에 쓰다니.”

findings.current: Energy churned at the sound of her cold voice.
findings.defect: Generic “Energy” misses the established Murim rendering of 기운.
findings.rationale: The source describes 기운 reacting alongside her voice in a Murim scene, not Hunter mana.
findings.replacement: Qi surged in time with her cold voice.
findings.source:
우우웅.

서늘한 목소리를 따라 요동치는 기운.

findings.current: After fighting the Fire King—that violent old man—to the death, you then fought the Sword Saint for hundreds of exchanges?
findings.defect: “Fighting … to the death” is awkward here and misses the established term for 생사결.
findings.rationale: 생사결 is a life-and-death duel; the revised line retains the Grand Mage’s incredulity without implying the Fire King died.
findings.replacement: After a life-and-death duel with the Fire King—that violent old man—you fought the Sword Saint for hundreds of exchanges?
findings.source: 화왕(火王), 그 난폭한 늙은이와 한바탕 생사결을 치르고도 검성과 수백 합을?

summary: The draft misattributes the Gansu defeat, implies the Blood Lord’s arm regrew, and loses several physical and character cues.
